rationale: Saurabh brings applied AI engineering experience across agents, LLM tooling, and developer infrastructure—skills directly relevant to Edgerun's edge AI inference systems. intro_message: Saurabh Khire, meet David Venegas — you both work in ML infrastructure from different angles (applied AI tooling vs. edge inference systems), and your complementary systems and optimization expertise could spark useful conversation.
